title: V01-C13 Functions and Contracts Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: Three explicit function contracts naming responsibility, accepted input, preconditions, outputs/postconditions, effects, and failure behavior, each supported by normal, boundary, and invalid tests.
A complete caller-to-callee and return-to-caller trace for nested calls, including arguments, call-specific state, return values, execution order, and failure boundary.

accessibility_requirements: Call diagrams include numbered text traces.
Contract tables label caller obligations and function guarantees.
Turkish terms include English only at first meaningful use.
Code comments and explanations are Turkish.
known_risks: A function may be treated as only a reusable code block.
Implementation details may be confused with contract guarantees.
Hidden globals may act as unstated inputs.
Effects and failure behavior may be omitted.
Definition may be confused with invocation.
Nested return flow may be traced in the wrong order.
JavaScript missing-return behavior may be misunderstood.
exclusions: parameter and argument mechanics in depth
